description: Utilities for time and date operations. Provides functions for getting current time, date and time information, and sleeping for specified durations.

instructions.description: Sleep for a specified amount of time.
instructions.name: Sleep

parameters.description: Milliseconds to sleep, must be a positive integer.
parameters.name: milliseconds

instructions.description:
Gets the current time expressed as number of milliseconds since January 1, 1970 (UTC).
This is also sometimes referred as unix timestamp.
instructions.name: Get current time

instructions.description:
Gets the current UTC date and time as an object:
```tel
{
  day: 10,    // 1 - 31
  hour: 9,    // 0 - 23
  minute: 4,  // 0 - 59
  month: 9,   // 1 - 12
  second: 47, // 0 - 59
  weekday: 1, // 0 is Monday, 1 Tuesday and so on...
  year: 2024
}
```
instructions.name: Get current date and time
